description: This script manages post-installation procedures for bundled plugins in an OpenClaw project. It discovers runtime dependencies, ensures they are installed, and automates npm installs if needed.

methods.name: readJson
methods.description: Reads and parses a JSON file from a given path.

methods.name: dependencySentinelPath
methods.description: Constructs the path to a dependency's package.json within node_modules.

methods.name: collectRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Combines dependencies and optionalDependencies fields from a package.json object.

methods.name: discoverBundledPluginRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Discovers and returns runtime dependencies for bundled plugins, optionally taking custom parameters.

methods.name: createNestedNpmInstallEnv
methods.description: Creates a clean environment object for npm install, removing certain config variables.

methods.name: isSourceCheckoutRoot
methods.description: Checks if a directory is a source checkout root based on presence of certain files/directories.

methods.name: shouldRunBundledPluginPostinstall
methods.description: Determines whether the post-install script should run based on environment and directory structure.

methods.name: runBundledPluginPostinstall
methods.description: Main function to run post-installation, ensuring dependencies are installed if required.
